scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/client
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.mts
scripts.test:deploy: npm run build -w packages/shared && node --import tsx --test tests/cloud-checkpoint.test.mts tests/frame-rate.test.mts tests/memory.test.mts tests/player-experience.test.mts tests/player.test.mts tests/session.test.mts tests/simulation.test.mts tests/socket-transport.test.mts
scripts.test:regression: npm run build -w packages/shared && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/cloud-checkpoint.test.mts tests/frame-rate.test.mts tests/memory.test.mts tests/player-experience.test.mts tests/player.test.mts tests/session.test.mts tests/simulation.test.mts tests/socket-transport.test.mts tests/server-startup.test.mts tests/film-story.test.mts tests/p0-journey.test.mts tests/neo-life.test.mts tests/sandbox.test.mts tests/story-sync.test.mts tests/film-world.test.mts tests/pills.test.mts tests/sandbox-panel-refresh.test.mts tests/film-journey-ui.test.mts tests/hel-garage-ui.test.mts tests/core-cast-delivery.test.mts tests/articulated-jaw.test.mts tests/eyelid-correctives.test.mts tests/iris-refraction.test.mts tests/nail-surface.test.mts tests/reference-skin-pigment.test.mts tests/skin-albedo.test.mts tests/skin-continuity-material.test.mts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client
